scope: Local build, compiled ARM emulation, SIM protocol, loopback HTTP and Edge browser; no hardware flash or NX deployment

checks: Motor fault cancels task, disarms and shows actionable cause
Readonly and reload snapshots retain fault and permissions
Explicit reset preserves history, invalidates pose and never resumes
Operator can start a new task after reference and explicit arm
Expired and faulted jogs release local busy; manual move becomes available
Recovery controls fit desktop and 760/390px layouts

regressions: Session before: frames 50/51; new session: frame 0 accepted and stable count reset; late retired session and duplicate new-session frame rejected
Actual loopback VisionPublisher recreation stamps a different session and accepts frame 0 after frame 50
Compiled ARM delayed STEP IRQ latches step_deadline; STOP cannot clear; ARM reports MOTION_FAULT_LATCHED
CLEAR requires all axes idle and disarmed, cannot truncate a stopping STEP high, retains fault total/reason and revokes navigation pose
An active lift loses its reference without resetting its estimated position; LIFT INIT on reconnect cannot restore it
Explicit known-position reference recovery supports nonzero configured lift bounds and rejects out-of-range or healthy-reference overwrite
CLEAR discards queued movement and held jog without implicit ARM
Controller acknowledgement cannot fabricate valid IMU feedback
